what: Master Version 2.12 — 23 MTH Tinplate rows from the Greenberg guide carried impossible 1979-1995 years; each takes the year of the same MTH product
source: [stated] Brad 2026-10-04: "can you google them?" → findings (MTH: first-ever Big Brute 2009, first Super 381 2011; every row matches MTH's own 2009-2016 product under the same number) → GREENBERG_YEARS_PLAN_2026-10-04.xlsx → "yes"; plan from a fresh read of MTH Tinplate after 2.11

cells.why: Googled: no early run exists with this year (MTH itself says the first-ever Big Brute was made in 2009 and the first Super 381 in 2011). The row is MTH's own product under this number — "Green & Cream Std. Gauge Lionel Corporation Tinplate No. 8 Pay-As-You-Enter Trolley (Traditional)" — so the 1979-1995 year from the guide is wrong. New year: the same product's own rows on this tab (11-2024-0 2011-2012, 11-2024-1 2011-2012) give 2011-2012.
